b-manual-1769202795651.title: Mine
b-manual-1769202795651.description:
One bad date. One dangerous stranger. One night that was never supposed to matter.
Kennedie Grey is new to Los Angeles, and determined to prove she belongs. As the newly appointed CEO of a powerful tech company, she can't afford distractions… or scandals.
But when her first date in the city humiliates her in the most unforgivable way, a stranger steps in.
Jian Liang is everything Kennedie should avoid, older, ruthless, and impossible to ignore. The wealthy owner of one of LA's most exclusive restaurant-and-hotel sanctuaries, he's known for his intelligence, his power… and the rumors no one dares say out loud.
What starts as a one-night escape turns into something neither of them expected.
Because Jian doesn't do casual. And once he gets his hands on Kennedie, he doesn't want one night, he wants all of her.
But desire has a cost.

mn0jh6lnu603.title: Seabrook's Broken Veil
mn0jh6lnu603.description:
Two thousand years after the Severance reshaped the world, peace is maintained by fragile agreements and powerful alliances.
When a coastal trade route fails and a human village cannot repay its debt, Isa makes a choice that will alter her life—and possibly the fate of Nijume itself.
To save her people from collapse, she agrees to leave her home under the protection of Rellan Seabrook, warlord of a formidable orc clan. Rellan expects obedience, negotiation, and settlement of what is owed. What he does not expect is Isa.
At nearly 179,000 words, Seabrook's Broken Veil is a full epic romance: a slow burn, a world built from the ground up, and a love story that earns every page.

b-manual-1769202658405.title: The Apology Wife
b-manual-1769202658405.description:
THE APOLOGY WIFE: Terms, Trust, and Legacy is a powerful stand-alone romance about scandal, survival, and the kind of love that refuses to stay pretend.
When a viral video brands billionaire CEO Han Joon-seo as a monster, the fallout doesn’t touch him—it destroys Skye Wallace, the Black Toronto woman caught in the crossfire. Fired, hunted by reporters, and drowning under her mother’s medical bills, Skye is running out of options.
Then Joon-seo finds her with an offer no sane woman would take… until she reads the terms.
Three years. A contract marriage. Fifty million dollars. Full protection. Full privacy. And enough money to give her mother a real chance at recovery—and Skye a chance to finish the architecture degree she sacrificed everything for.
It was supposed to be business. A clean solution. A public apology.

b-manual-1772668006973.title: The Bet
b-manual-1772668006973.description:
A thousand-dollar wager. Eight months of watching her from across the room. One chance to prove the bet was never the point.
Bobbie Shaw stopped believing in romance three years ago, when she overheard her fiancé call her a consolation prize. Now she runs the most sought-after event planning company in Los Angeles, and she doesn't let anyone close enough to hurt her again.
Elias Wren has wanted her since the moment he saw her. But he's spent ten years as a partner at a firm that rewards silence over integrity—and when his business partner bets him a thousand dollars to seduce her, he takes it. Not for the money. For the excuse.
What starts as a lie becomes the most honest thing he's ever felt.
Then she finds out.
Now Elias has to prove—publicly, on his knees, in front of everyone who watched her get humiliated—that Bobbie Shaw was never the prize.

b-manual-1772668183445.title: The One
b-manual-1772668183445.description:
He made a bet about her best friend's body. Now he wants a chance with hers.
Nina Okafor doesn't do second chances. She runs Shaw Events, she holds her own, and she learned a long time ago exactly what kind of woman a man like Jason Whitmore keeps — and it isn't her. Not in the light. Not in front of people who matter.
So when they end up in the same hotel bar after a charity gala, with no names exchanged and nothing at stake, one night feels like something she can survive intact.
She's wrong.
Jason Whitmore has spent the last year becoming someone different. Not because anyone asked him to — because he stood in a parking garage with a broken nose and a clear accounting of the man he'd been, and decided that man wasn't worth keeping. He's done the work. He's burned the bridges. He's ready.
He just needs Nina to believe him.

b-manual-1769202732222.title: Names We Inherit
b-manual-1769202732222.description:
Xola Grier does not chase happy endings. She chases proof.
Six feet tall, curvy, and sharp enough to cut through a lie, Xola built her career reuniting families because she never had one to return to. Raised as a ward of the state in Atlanta, she learned early that names can be taken, changed, and buried, and that truth is never free.
So when Avery Moore, a wealthy mixed-race woman, hires Xola to find the Japanese mother she has been separated from for more than forty years, Xola takes the case for one reason. Time is running out.
Avery’s father, Leon, is dying. Dementia has been stealing him piece by piece, but one memory keeps surfacing. The woman he loved, the woman he lost, the mother Avery deserves to meet before grief makes it impossible.

b-manual-1770230257119.title: Blood & Roses
b-manual-1770230257119.description:
She rules Boston as Pakhan. He arranges flowers that make the city stop and stare.
When grief puts them in the same room, a gunshot at the grave binds their fates.
Janelle Mikalov is the Bratva boss of Boston, a queen who never begs and never bows. The day she buries her mother, she walks into an Irish florist’s shop to drown the church in roses. Mac O’Connell is steady, masculine, and loyal to his craft. He insists on handling every stem himself. At the cemetery, he delivers the flowers in person. The rival Irish syndicate takes the shot. Janelle drops him to the ground and returns fire without blinking.
The war does not end there.

b-manual-1770230249694.title: The Cabin
b-manual-1770230249694.description:
Brielle Beaumont doesn’t lose control.
She’s a Denver high-asset divorce attorney with a spotless reputation and a spine made of steel—until a bitter billionaire tries to wreck her career with a bad-faith ethics complaint. She survives it. She moves on. She doesn’t look back.
Then she walks into a luxury mountain cabin for a “relaxing couples weekend”…
…and finds Logan Van Zandt already there.
Logan is private equity rich, Boulder-polished, and still furious about the divorce he “won” but paid for anyway. Brielle is the lawyer who made the settlement happen—and the woman he’s never stopped blaming for the humiliation that followed.
They didn’t agree to this setup.
They didn’t consent to being cornered together.
And the storm outside makes leaving impossible.

b-manual-1770230253746.title: The Yacht
b-manual-1770230253746.description:
Junie Everhart makes rich people’s lives run on time. Private client concierge. Invitation-only. Discretion as a weapon.
So when her VIP orders her to attend a charity gala aboard The Black Regalia, Junie does what she always does—keeps the client steady, keeps the cameras happy, keeps the chaos contained.
Except this yacht isn’t a fundraiser.
It’s a marketplace—champagne on the top deck, leverage below. And Junie’s access—her ability to move through doors other people can’t—makes her the cleanest pressure point in the room.
Cyril Mattei doesn’t do small problems. Corsican. Controlled. Built like a final decision. He’s on The Black Regalia because he can smell a setup before it snaps shut.

b-16-1764535451710.title: Marked by Flames 2nd Edition
b-16-1764535451710.description:
She didn’t come to Emberrun to be claimed. She came to survive.
But fate doesn’t ask. It marks. It burns. And it doesn’t let go.
Kiya Cain fled a past soaked in pain, silence, and blood. She didn’t come looking for wolves. She didn’t come looking for fire. But when she crashes into a strange Vermont town wrapped in mist and moonlight, she finds both — waiting, watching, and ready to rise.
Kael. Ronan. Orren. Three Sovar — alpha-born shifters bonded by law, memory, and magic. They don’t just want her. They were made for her.
Because Kiya isn’t just a woman. She’s the Solenya. The flame-bringer. The one who can complete the bond — or burn the pack to ash.

b-6-1764535451710.title: Viktor's Elena
b-6-1764535451710.description:
He came to America to disappear. She made him want a life.
Elena Carter is nineteen, broke, and disciplined enough to turn double shifts and nursing school into something that looks like a future. She works a D.C. jazz club where men come to drink, lie, and take what they want.
Then Viktor starts showing up every Tuesday.
He sits in the corner like the room is a threat assessment. He tips like money is an apology. He speaks like every word costs. He does not flirt. He does not push. He watches Elena like he is trying to memorize the parts of her the world will try to ruin.
Elena is not the kind of woman who gets dazzled. She gets curious. Then she gets reckless.

b-manual-1769203165328.title: So, About Last Night Books 1-6
b-manual-1769203165328.description:
One night. One decision. No going back.
So, About Last Night is a collection of steamy, emotionally intense BWWM romance novellas where love collides with power, danger, and consequence. Each story stands alone and follows a different couple pulled together by a single, life-changing night.
From Chicago penthouses and glass-walled boardrooms to roadside motels and backroom deals, these stories dive into the lives of men who live on the edge—some with more money than they can ever spend, some with nothing left except their next bad decision—until they meet her.
They’re Dons, CEOs, outlaws, best men, and ex-cons trying to outrun their pasts. Some run companies. Some run crews. Some are just trying to keep their heads above water. What they share is danger, loyalty, and the kind of pull you only get from a man who has something—or nothing—to lose.

b-18-1764535451710.title: Forecheck, Backcheck, Heartcheck
b-18-1764535451710.description:
Jordan meets Kris at a gas station at midnight. He's blasting SZA's "Snooze" from his G-Wagon. She's a single mom and romance author driving home in her red QUEEN MADE hoodie. He's a 6'7" Swedish NHL player who's tired of being just a number on a jersey.
The chemistry is instant. But Jordan has a three-year-old son and rules about who she lets into their life. Kris has a hockey schedule that keeps him on the road for weeks at a time. Her ex-husband chose his career over their family. His body is aging out of the only thing he's ever known how to be.
This is about two people who've learned to protect themselves trying to figure out if they're brave enough to let each other in.

b-manual-1764539624555.title: The Office
b-manual-1764539624555.description:
Lennox Cross didn’t fight her way to Vice President of Logistics at Thorne Freight just to become office gossip.
Her job is simple, keep cargo moving, keep profits up, and keep as much distance as possible from Xavier Thorne, the ruthless CEO who signs her checks and watches her like a problem he can’t quite solve. For three years they’ve circled each other in boardrooms and late-night strategy calls, all sharp edges and unspoken heat.
Then a Christmas Eve blizzard shuts down Chicago.
With the city frozen, the company’s biggest holiday shipment on the line, and the rest of the staff sent home, Lennox and Xavier are stranded together in his glass-walled corner office. One night of bad decisions changes everything, shattering every rule, including the no-fraternization policy Xavier wrote himself.
When the snow clears, the real storm hits.

b-manual-1764694488516.title: The Outlaw
b-manual-1764694488516.description:
Knox Callahan walks out of an Illinois prison with forty dollars in his pocket, ten years of rage in his chest, and one plan—track down the motorcycle club president who framed him and end it. No roots. No ties. No future. Just revenge.
Then a flickering neon sign and an all-night diner change everything.
Jessie Moore is the graveyard-shift waitress at The Night Owl, a small-town survivor who’s learned to keep her head down and her tips hidden. On paper she’s free. In reality she’s trapped under a badge—stalked and controlled by a local deputy who treats her like property and laughs at her restraining order. Jessie’s saving every dollar for a one-way bus ticket out of town… until a scarred, tattooed ex-con with ice-blue eyes takes the back booth and sees the bruises she’s trying to hide.

b-15-1764535451710.title: The Widow
b-15-1764535451710.description:
She buried a king. Now she wears his crown.
When her husband, the ruthless Albanian mob boss Marko Kolari, is gunned down in a public ambush, Domonique Kolari becomes a woman the underworld never saw coming—beautiful, grieving, and far more dangerous than anyone imagined.
Every man at her husband’s funeral swore loyalty. Only one kept his promise.
Julian Daku, Marko’s most trusted friend, steps in to protect her, to steady the empire… and to guide her through the savage world her husband left behind.
But grief has a taste. Power has a scent. And late at night, when the city sleeps, loyalty blurs into something darker.

b-5-1764535451710.title: Reign Over Vengeance
b-5-1764535451710.description:
He was forged in violence. She was built for war. And together, they chose vengeance, not mercy.
Luca Mikhailov rules Baltimore with blood-stained hands and a brutal code: no second chances, no loose ends. As heir to a fractured Bratva empire, he’s learned to wield pain like a weapon—and trust no one.
Enter Isadora Laurent. A black-market arms queen feared from Lagos to Berlin. Untouchable. Untraceable. Unforgiving. She’s returned to the city that slaughtered her father—not for redemption, but retribution.
What begins as a lethal business exchange spirals into a volatile alliance.
She’s the only woman who doesn’t flinch under his threats.
He’s the only man who can match her fire.

b-14-1764535451710.title: The Wedding
b-14-1764535451710.description:
Sebastian Kole has everything—billions in the bank, a company he built from the ground up, and the crushing weight of being the perfect son. But when a chance encounter at a Nashville hotel bar turns into the hottest night of his life, he wakes up wanting more than his family’s approval. He wants her.
Lyrical “Lyric” James doesn’t apologize for who she is. A dancer who owns her choices, she’s used to whispers and judgment—but nothing prepares her for Sebastian: powerful, controlled, and watching her like she’s the only real thing he’s ever seen.
When fate throws them together again at his brother’s wedding, sparks ignite into scandal. One slur. One fist. One declaration in front of everyone. And suddenly, the dutiful CEO isn’t at the altar—he’s holding Lyric’s hand, walking away from everything he was supposed to be.

b-4-1764535451710.title: Kill Code Kingdom
b-4-1764535451710.description:
He was the family's quiet weapon. She was the only mind fast enough to match him. Together they will teach an empire how it feels to be hunted.
Finn O'Connell was built to disappear. Mac O'Connell's youngest, the syndicate's tech mastermind, he can break into anything and leave no fingerprint, no shadow, no proof he was ever there. But the man they call The Bishop is no ordinary mark. He's a ghost with too much power, too many soldiers, and a thirty-year grudge he has been feeding in the dark while everyone else looked away.
Then the war comes home.

b-9-1764535451710.title: Ruined
b-9-1764535451710.description:
She came for the wedding. He came to disappear.
Tasha Montgomery doesn’t do slow, soft, or second chances. She’s got the attitude, the curves, and the career to make most men flinch and she likes it that way. Love? Overrated. Men? Useful at best. Until one weekend in the middle of nowhere shoves a cowboy into her path that doesn’t flinch at all.
Waylon Boone McCrae isn’t just country. He is country. All slow drawl, rough hands, and brooding silence, six foot seven of farm-raised strength and barely tamed heat. He came to D.C. for a wedding, ready to hate every second of it. Then Tasha walks in.
Sharp-tongued. Beautiful. Untouchable.
And everything he’s never let himself want.

b-11-1764535451710.title: Fractured
b-11-1764535451710.description:
She came to heal. He came to bleed. Together, they burn.
Amira Holloway didn’t move to this wreck of a coastal town to fall in love. She came to work, to rebuild, to prove she could carry her own scars and still stand tall. But when a battered, dangerous fighter stumbles into her care, her carefully built walls start to crack.
Lucas Vega is chaos wrapped in muscle and ink. A man who takes pain like oxygen and gives it back twice as hard. The last thing he should want is the sharp-tongued nurse who patches him up. The last thing Amira should crave is a man like him.
But want doesn’t ask permission. It demands.

b-10-1764535451710.title: Inked
b-10-1764535451710.description:
A fallen chef. A fixer with rules. A city that will eat them alive if they slip.
Reid Callahan walked out of Michelin kitchens in flames, trading knives for needles and fire for ink. His shop is clean, his rules are strict, and his past is viral infamy the internet refuses to forget. He does not need redemption. He needs silence, steel, and clients who respect the chair.
Asha Nwosu is hired to keep him untouchable. A fixer who thrives on order, she is paid to kill leaks, bury scandals, and hold her clients steady when the city tries to break them. She does not sleep with clients. She does not bend rules. She does not lose.
But in the quiet between headlines and needle hum, want takes shape. Sharp. Hungry. Dangerous.

b-13-1764535451710.title: The Penthouse
b-13-1764535451710.description:
Her ex’s betrayal was bad… but falling for his father might ruin them all.
Zuri had every reason to celebrate.
Biggest contract of her career signed, a man waiting upstairs who promised dinner — maybe more.
Instead, she walked in on Nolan with another woman.
No yelling. No tears. Just a straight walk out the door… and right into the path of his father.
Alistair MacLeod is everything Nolan isn’t — older, taller, broader, with that deep Scottish voice that makes your bones vibrate. He owns the building, the bar downstairs, and the kind of presence that makes people listen when he talks.
One drink turned into two hours.
Two hours turned into an invitation upstairs.
And upstairs? That changed everything.

b-3-1764535451710.title: No Cure For Claimed
b-3-1764535451710.description:
The shift was supposed to end with chart notes and a clean set of scrubs. Instead, Jasira Vass is on the floor of Mercy General with her hands buried in a dying man's chest while gunfire tears the hospital apart.
She doesn't run. She spent ten years keeping Marines alive under fire; one bleeding mobster on her trauma floor doesn't rattle her. She doesn't break, either. But when the smoke clears, she's standing in the crosshairs of the Bratva, marked for a kill order she never earned, and the only thing between her and a body bag is the Irish syndicate's most feared enforcer.
Ronan O'Connell. Lieutenant. Executioner. The man the O'Connells send when they need the bodies to stay quiet.

b-12-1764535451710.title: The Don
b-12-1764535451710.description:
One night. No promises. Just the kind of touch that ruins you forever.
Reyna Dorne is a brilliant defense attorney with a sharp mouth, a flawless win record—and no time for entanglements. But when a brooding stranger with eyes like war offers her one night with no strings, she says yes.
Just once. Just him. Just the night.
She doesn’t expect the way he touches her. She doesn’t expect to fall.
And she never expects him to disappear before dawn.
Vadim is the kind of man who doesn’t get second chances.
Pakhan of the Russian mafia. Cold-blooded. Controlled.
He knows better than to want a woman like Reyna—loud, brilliant, curvy as sin.
But wanting her was never the problem.

b-8-1764535451710.title: Savor
b-8-1764535451710.description:
Simone Ellis never expected to inherit a house, a recipe box, and a legacy built on sugar and secrets. But when her grandmother passes, she returns to Sable Lake—and walks straight into the arms of a man with storm-gray eyes, calloused hands, and grief stitched into every quiet breath.
Grant Mercer isn’t looking for comfort. He’s just trying to survive—raising his daughter, running the town’s bakery, and pretending he didn’t break the day he buried his wife. But Simone arrives with hips that don’t lie, recipes that resurrect memory, and a mouth made for truth. And suddenly, comfort isn’t the only thing he’s starving for.

b-7-1764535451710.title: Unbound
b-7-1764535451710.description:
Evangeline Fox wasn’t looking for comfort, just a way to survive the fallout. A high-profile betrayal. A public breakup. The kind of heartbreak that turns your name into a headline.
She escapes to a remote cabin, hoping for silence. Instead, she finds two men already there.
Corbin Deveraux is all sharp control and buried fire.
Silas Kingsley is wild energy in a tailored suit, dangerous, infuriating, impossible to ignore.
Best friends. Billionaires. And both watching her like she’s the only thing that could undo them.
What begins as a standoff in a snowstorm turns into something far more intimate, hotter, riskier, and deeply emotional. As desire builds and boundaries blur, Evangeline stops asking which man to choose... and starts wondering what it would mean to have both.

b-1-1764535451710.title: Bound by Fire
b-1-1764535451710.description:
She was supposed to be untouchable. Now she's the only thing he will burn the city down to keep.
Liam O'Connell was bred for violence. Mac O'Connell's brother and the syndicate's second-in-command, he was built to carry out the family's will, not to fall for a woman with a sharp mouth and sharper secrets. After a war nearly shattered the O'Connell empire, distraction is a luxury he can't afford. And Ava Sinclair is all fire and fury, scars she refuses to show and a tongue that draws blood. She was never part of the plan.
Then the ambush comes.
Ava ends up wounded and hunted, a target in a war she didn't start, and Liam doesn't hesitate. He locks her inside Ravenhurst, the O'Connell fortress no one walks out of uninvited. Under his guard. Under his control. And far too close to a need neither of them can outrun.

b-2-1764535451710.title: Savage Devotion
b-2-1764535451710.description:
He buried the woman he loved. This is not a tender love story born in peace. This is war. And Nova was never meant to be his salvation. Until she was.
Nova Blake has always belonged to CJ O'Connell, at least in the shadows. But the day he buried Natalia, he buried every soft thing left in him and walked away from the family, the war, and the woman who knew him before the grief swallowed him whole.
Now Nova drags him back into the light, whether he wants it or not. She is hip-deep in a blood war, cracking Bratva networks from behind a screen, hunting the men who turned CJ into a ghost. And she wants the one thing he swore he would never give again.
Love.

b-0-1764535451710.title: Dark Vows
b-0-1764535451710.description:
She built her life far from bloodlines and violent kings.
But in Boston, power has a name—and it never forgets.
Janelle Carter doesn’t take orders. She doesn’t chase chaos. And she sure as hell doesn’t bow to men like Cormac “Mac” O’Connell—the Irish mafia kingpin born into an empire of blood and steel.
For generations, the O'Connell's have ruled Boston from the shadows. With ancient estates, billion-dollar holdings, and brutal alliances stitched in violence, Mac doesn’t answer to anyone. He commands cities. He carves legacy into bone.
Mac is cold-blooded, calculating, and built to dominate.
And when Janelle crosses into his world, he doesn’t ask.
He claims.
He’s not her savior. He’s her storm.
And walking away was never an option.

mpo8w9roo2ry.title: Madame Cipher
mpo8w9roo2ry.description:
She built a billion-dollar empire on one rule: never need anything you can't provide for yourself.
At thirty-seven, Cipher has the money, the power, and the reputation. She's the kind of woman who ends meetings with a look and runs a tech empire that answers to no one but her. She hasn't cried in fifteen years. Hasn't let anyone close in two. Hasn't stopped performing long enough to notice that the woman behind the armor is running on empty.
Then the black envelope arrives.
DIAMOND CODE.
No address. No explanation. Just an invitation to twenty-four hours inside a world built for women exactly like her, powerful, isolated, and starving for something they don't have language for yet.
Sir Rune has that language.

mpo96dnhe6r1.title: The Don: King Takes Queen
mpo96dnhe6r1.description:
He left to protect her.
She spent seven years deciding what to do about that.
When Reyna Dorne finds a key charm in her mailbox on her daughter's seventh birthday, one word engraved on the silver, she understands exactly what Vadim Dragunov has been trying to say. ВСЕГДА. Always.
She is done waiting for always.
Armed with seven years of evidence, a forensic accountant, and the legal precision that has defined her entire career, Reyna goes looking for the door the key opens. What she finds is a man who never stopped watching. A threat he has not yet finished dismantling. And a collision that has been building since the night she walked out of his hotel room and rebuilt her life from scratch.
But Vadim is not the only one who has been paying attention.

mpo9dscncl68.title: Strongman Season
mpo9dscncl68.description:
Her grandfather left her a Highland cottage, three hundred thousand pounds, and a debt she never asked to inherit.
Devyn MacKinnon is thirty-three, burning out behind her camera, and very done with people making decisions for her. When a Scottish solicitor’s letter lands on her Chicago doorstep, complete with a dead grandfather’s confession, a stone cottage, and a one-year ultimatum, she doesn’t go for forgiveness. She goes for the money, the house, and the answers her father took to his grave.
Lachlan MacGregor thought he knew what his village was. He thought he knew what his father was. He didn’t account for the Black American photographer who moves in, pushes back against everything, and makes the place feel like something worth fighting for.

mpo9f9esk5zu.title: Black Tie Violence
mpo9f9esk5zu.description:
She came to Bangkok for a deal. She found a war.
Cyan St. James doesn't make mistakes. The Black American hospitality executive has spent four years rebuilding her career after a powerful man stole her work and used their affair to destroy her reputation. Now she's SVP at Aurelius Hotels, sent to close an acquisition that will cement her comeback.
She doesn't plan on Niran Wongchai.
He fights because it's the only honest thing left.
Thai billionaire. Muay Thai champion. The man they call the Chairman. Niran inherited an empire built on corruption and has spent eleven years trying to clean it. He doesn't let anyone close. Doesn't need anyone. Doesn't want the American executive who shows up at his fight and watches him break a man without flinching.
Then someone puts her in the wrong seat. His mother's seat. And Niran realizes they're both being played.

mpzefnolllko.title: Blood Price
mpzefnolllko.description:
Cristiano Bellori counts everything. It's the only way to silence the chaos in his mind. The only way to survive as heir to Miami's most powerful crime family. Then his father is assassinated, the empire falls to him, and the enemies start circling.
Romy Cole was just a bartender working the wrong shift. She wasn't supposed to witness a murder. She wasn't supposed to catch the eye of the most dangerous man in Miami. And she definitely wasn't supposed to end up with a twenty-million-dollar bounty on her head.
Now she's trapped in Cristiano's world. His home. His war. His obsession. He says he's protecting her. He says he'll keep her alive. But the way he looks at her, the way he touches her, the way he counts against her skin when the darkness gets too close...
That's not protection. That's possession.

mq5o9v1hhxrc.title: Bound by Fire 2nd Edition
mq5o9v1hhxrc.description:
She was supposed to be untouchable. Now she's the only thing he will burn the city down to keep.

mq5obmc50w6g.description:

mq5ockixc1qd.description:
He was the family's quiet weapon. She was the only mind fast enough to match him. Together they will teach an empire how it feels to be hunted.
Finn O'Connell was built to disappear. Mac O'Connell's youngest, the syndicate's tech mastermind, he can break into anything and leave no fingerprint, no shadow, no proof he was ever there. But the man they call The Bishop is no ordinary mark. He's a ghost with too much power, too many soldiers, and a thirty-year grudge he has been feeding in the dark while everyone else looked away.
Then the war comes home.

mtkrjwd0okz2.title: Hudson & Frankie
mtkrjwd0okz2.description:
Frankie Marlowe runs the rare bookstore her late mother built, and she does not have time for nonsense. Not from her customers. Not from her grief. Definitely not from the six-foot-three Irishman bleeding to death on her hardwood floors at closing time.
She gets the dish towel before she gets the panic.
She tells him to mind her display cases.
She locks the door behind him when he leaves and assumes that's the end of it.
It is not.
Hudson Roarke runs Philadelphia. Three generations of Roarke men have run this city before him, and he has spent fifteen years making sure no one ever forgets it. He has buried his father. Buried his mother. Buried the men who killed both of them. He has not laughed in years. He has not been touched by anything in longer than he can remember.

mtkrl59z3819.title: Grown & Chosen
mtkrl59z3819.description:
Four women who know exactly what they're worth. Four men who would never ask them to be smaller.
Four complete, high-heat AMBW romances. No cliffhangers. No reading order. Four grown Black women, four powerful men who choose all of them, and four cities where love collides with power, family, and danger.
MINE — Los Angeles. A Chinese-American man with ties he can't outrun. A Black CEO holding a seat her own company never wanted her in. A claim that turns dangerous the moment the wrong people notice her.
THE APOLOGY WIFE — Toronto to Korea. A Korean-Canadian billionaire whose empire has no successor. A woman fighting to keep her mother alive. An arrangement that was never supposed to become real, and a devotion that rewrites what family means.

mtkrmaoxthdn.title: Again With Feeling
mtkrmaoxthdn.description:
She died on a Tuesday. She woke up four weeks earlier, in a marriage she's about to lose.
Saidah Coker built a beauty empire with her own two hands and a personality that takes up every room she enters. Loud. Difficult. Unwinnable. It's the woman she had to become to survive, and she's certain it's the woman who's killing her marriage.
So when she gets a second chance, a real one, she knows exactly what to fix. She'll be calm. Easy. Restful. She'll become the soft, quiet wife she's sure her husband always wanted.
She's wrong about all of it.

mtkrnb9rnbb9.title: Present Tense
mtkrnb9rnbb9.description:
He rebuilt his whole life around never feeling this again. She walked in anyway.
The connection you met in Mine: A Dangerous Claim gets its own story. Reese Hollis and Joaquin Zannis step out of the background and into the center of a love story about grief, second chances, and the ordinary life you have to be brave enough to want.
Detective Joaquin Zannis has spent two years running his grief like a machine. Get the kid to school. Work the scene. Sleep on one side of the bed. Feel nothing, and nothing can be taken from you again. It's not a life. It's a system. And it works, right up until the night a woman with a fake recipe and a real problem gets his number.

mtkrop0ywb2d.title: Something Like Spring
mtkrop0ywb2d.description:
She was told her season was over. He arrived like spring.
Vanessa Summers is fifty years old, freshly divorced, and finally free. Discarded by the husband who traded her for a younger woman, she's spent six years rebuilding a life on her own terms: her own name, her own money, her own quiet. She's not looking for love. She's certain that part of her life is closed for good.
Then she walks out of her favorite restaurant with the wrong bag of takeout, refuses to apologize for it, and comes face to face with the most dangerous man in the city.

mtkrq3shm3ij.title: Why Choose
mtkrq3shm3ij.description:
She was always too much. They think she's exactly enough.
Sammy Whitaker strips motorcycles down to the frame and builds them back better. She has the skill, the following, and a life she keeps deliberately small, because every man before taught her the same lesson: want less, be less, take up less room.
Then three men who own the best custom shop in Denver slide into her messages. Identical twins and the quiet best friend they grew up with. They admire the work. They admit the attraction. And they want her on their floor.
She comes for the job. She stays for a reason she can't say out loud.

mtkrre783fwu.title: Fairplay, Power Play, Breakaway
mtkrre783fwu.description:
He's the league's most notorious heartbreaker. She's the one woman who isn't impressed.
You met them in Forecheck, Backcheck, Heartcheck. She was the ride-or-die best friend who never bit her tongue. He was the teammate the whole locker room warned each other about. Now it's their turn.
Dr. Brielle Calloway built her name from nothing. Her own veterinary practice. Her own rules. A life she claws back control of every single day — because she learned young that the people who are supposed to stay are the ones who walk out the door.

mtkrsmelc14n.title: Out of the Smoke
mtkrsmelc14n.description:
For eighteen years, she has been the best in the world at taking what cannot be taken.
She is a generalist thief who leaves no mark, no trace, no name. She works elite jobs for people who can afford the loss, and she has never once had to hurt anyone to do it. She built her whole life on one belief: she is alone, she is careful, and that is why she is clean.
She is wrong about all three.
When a client refuses to pay and sells her name to the powerful people she has stolen from over the years, she becomes the target of a hunt too big and too fast for any one woman to outrun. And out of the shadows steps a man she does not know, who knows everything about her. A former special-squad sniper who has kept her alive for almost twenty years without her ever seeing his face.

mtkrtky85dy4.title: Seabrook's Silent Root
mtkrtky85dy4.description:
The gate held. The alliance formed. The world the Synod spent two thousand years keeping silent has begun, at last, to speak.
And somewhere to the south, it is calling again.
At over 126,000 words, Seabrook's Silent Root is a full-length epic romance, and a harder-driving one than the first, built like the road it follows: relentless, closing, impossible to set down.

mtks7zil3oks.title: The Wrong Number
mtks7zil3oks.description:
She had two Christophers in her phone. She texted the wrong one.
Leslie O'Neill doesn't do romance anymore. She did it once, it cost her, and she rebuilt her whole life around not needing anyone. Now she's got a business she loves, a client list that keeps her busy, and exactly zero patience for the blind date her best friend keeps pushing.
Fine. One text. A little wine, a little courage, one message to see if this "Christopher" even has a personality.
He does. He's dry, he's quick, he's the best conversation she's had in years. So she keeps texting. Keeps flirting. Keeps saying things she'd never say out loud to a man's face.
There's just one problem.
She's not texting her blind date. She's texting Christopher McDaniels, media mogul, her brother's boss, and a man who knew exactly who she was from the very first message.

mtks9c9m7c1s.title: The Destination
mtks9c9m7c1s.description:
She flew to Iceland to say goodbye to her best friend.
One carry-on. Diana's ashes. A trip they were supposed to take together that Sadia Winter is now taking alone, because that is what she does, handles everything, needs no one, keeps moving.
Then she sits down next to him on the plane.
Kelvar Vik is Icelandic, built like something that grew out of the landscape, and the most present man she has ever encountered. He listens the way most people don't. He says things and means them and leaves them where they land without needing to build anything on top of them. By the time the plane touches down in Reykjavík, she has told him more about Diana than she has told anyone since October.
She tells herself it's just the altitude.

mv8lgost78gq.title: The Ache Boxset: Savor & ruined
mv8lgost78gq.description:
Two best friends. Two men who don't do halfway. One season that ruins them both for anyone else.
Two complete BWWM contemporary romances from The Ache, together for the first time, Savor and Ruined, plus an exclusive bonus chapter you won't find anywhere else.

series.Vows & Vengeance: Vows & Vengeance is Raven DeNoir's debut saga, a BWWM powerhouse set in the brutal underworlds of Boston, Baltimore, and beyond. Irish kings, Black heroines who never bow, vows sealed in blood, and HEAs carved from chaos. Start with Dark Vows, where trust is earned in blood and love refuses to ask permission.
series.The Ache: The Ache delivers emotionally raw, high-heat BWWM romance in both novels and sharp, addictive novellas. Each standalone centers a strong Black woman who chooses herself first, matched with a man who meets her where she stands. No fade to black, only grown-folks love that heals what hurt, whether in bakery kitchens, storm-lashed cabins, small-town dive bars, or sleek penthouses.
series.So, About Last Night: So, About Last Night explores the morning after a choice that changed everything. Short, sultry BWWM stories that begin with desire and tell the truth about consequence. Some nights save a marriage, some reopen old wounds, some end in silence or blood, yet every one is unforgettable.
series.The Emberrun: The Emberrun is a dark, shifter-paranormal BWWM romance set in a cursed Vermont mountain town where the forest watches and the wolves keep score. Three Hollowborn alphas bound by fire, one Solenya who was never meant to survive, fated mates, primal rituals, found family, and a heroine who refuses to bow, even to destiny.
